description: This file defines the cSettings class, which manages configuration settings stored in a JSON-like structure, providing methods to get, set, check, remove, and persist key-value pairs. It includes file I/O operations, JSON data handling, and utility functions for file existence checks.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class that manages configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with capabilities to read from and write to a file, and manipulate key-value pairs.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, attempts to read existing configuration from file, or creates a new file if not present.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the JSON data.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key-value pair in the JSON data, supporting string, int, and bool types.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists and is non-empty in the JSON data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the JSON data by setting its value to empty and removing the key.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes the JSON object from the configuration file.
